title: S-05 Transactions and UTXOs are keyed by global txid; a second wallet in the same store never gets the transaction

title: SPV-07 computeMerkleRoot ignores offsets/multi-path BUMPs; validateMerklePath skips single-leaf levels

title: BlockHeaderChain.validateMerkleProof treats MerkleProof.merkleProof as a sibling list; proofs are now raw BUMP hex
description: Found by the BUMP lane. After SPV-06 the projection (and ARCActor already) store MerkleProof.merkleProof as [rawBumpHex]. BlockHeaderChain.validateMerkleProof (no lib callers today) still walks it as a list of sibling hashes and would misread those proofs. Parse raw hex via CryptoUtils.buildBUMPFromMerkleProof / BUMP.fromHex and use BUMP.computeMerkleRoot. Relevant to SPV-09 (verify imported/ARC proofs against the header chain).

title: SPV-06 Library-built BUMPs are not BRC-74 compliant (two incompatible internal layouts)
description: tsc_converter.dart:105-114; crypto_utils.dart:685-757 (also 247-293, 622-682); wallet_projection.dart:820-843. TscConverter emits level 0 = sibling only; buildBUMPFromMerkleProof emits level 0 = txid only with siblings pushed one level up; _storeMerkleProofFromBump assumes layout A. Outgoing BEEFs (payment_coordinator_actor.dart:1015, ancestor_chain_service.dart:199) carry non-standard BUMPs rejected by reference verifiers. Fix: one BRC-74 builder (txid + sibling at level 0, one sibling per level, duplicate flags), store raw BUMP hex, fixture test against a known vector.
close_reason: Fixed on main: single BRC-74 builder and merkle walk, TSC duplicates, raw BUMP stored in the projection; tests fail on old code, pass on new.

title: SPV-04 CDN header sync trusts the CDN entirely (checkpoints from manifest, no anchor, PoW off, HTTP allowed)
description: cdn_header_sync_service.dart:91,147-148,195-209; cdn_manifest.dart:50,78-80; cdn_header_sync_config.dart:54. Expected hashes and 'checkpoints' come from manifest.json on the same origin; first chunk on an empty DB is unanchored; validateProofOfWork defaults false; baseUrl not required to be https; bulkImportHeaders writes without validation; genesis chunk skipped on empty DB. Fix: ship genesis + checkpoint hashes in code, require the first imported header to link, enforce https, PoW on by default.
close_reason: Fixed in commit on main (SPV-04): genesis anchor via NetworkParams, PoW on by default, https required, genesis-chunk resume bug. Nine tests fail on old code, pass on new.

title: Payment coordinator hard-codes m/0/<index> public-key paths; change-chain UTXOs need isChangeFlags on SignTransactionCommand
description: Found by the H3 lane. payment_coordinator_actor.dart ~838 builds publicKeys with 'm/0/${derivationIndex}' regardless of AddressMetadata.isChange (the projection stores it). The aggregate ignores publicKeys when signing P2PKH so signing works, but anything consuming publicKeys is wrong for change UTXOs. Fix with A-H8/KM-4/KM-5 (libspiffy-leo): pass isChangeFlags from the read model and use the right chain in the path. Also note receive and change chains share nextDerivationIndex (harmless gaps).

title: SPV-02 Header chain has no genesis/checkpoint anchor, no difficulty validation, no fork choice
description: block_header_chain.dart:284-348; spiffynode_bridge.dart:258-259. _validateHeader only checks prev-hash when the previous header exists, so the first header from whichever peer answers is accepted; PoW is checked against the header's own bits with no retarget/powLimit check; timestamp check is only > 0; validateAndStoreHeader advances the tip on height >= bestHeight with no chainwork comparison. A malicious first peer installs a fake chain. Fix: per-network genesis/checkpoints in code, validate bits against expected difficulty (or at least powLimit + max step), future-timestamp bound, cumulative-chainwork fork choice.

title: SPV-03 Reorg handling is a no-op and reorg batches are mis-heighted; wallet stalls on a stale branch

title: KM-4 Plugin transaction path signs all funding inputs with one key derived from selectedUtxos.first
